Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using V5-tagged KIF5A. Quantification was performed using iBAQ, which is a label-free approach. Acquisition was explicitly stated as DDA.

scope: To identify differentially interacting proteins, we transfected SKNAS cells with V5-tagged KIF5AWT and KIF5AΔExon27 and immunoprecipitated the tagged proteins
V5-antibody conjugated magnetic beads (MBL), were washed 3x with 1X PBS+0.1% Tween 20 (PBS-T) before combining it with lysate
For mass spec identification of KIF5A binding partners, the proteins were eluted by incubating the beads twice in 30ul of “soft elution buffer”
Immunoprecipitated elution samples were analyzed by LC-MS/MS at UMASS Mass Spectrophotometry Facility.
